sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return tuple(''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
seq=[glyph(51,59,12,22)]
blue0=glyph(40,48,12,22)
for i in range(20):
    action(['UP'])
    g=glyph(51,59,12,22)
    seq.append(g)
    if i<3: print(i+1, list(g))
    if g==seq[0]:
        print("cycle closed at", i+1); break
print("blue0 unchanged:", glyph(40,48,12,22)==blue0)
print("seq len:", len(seq))
for i,g in enumerate(seq):
    print(i, g)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def glyph(r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return tuple(''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
seq=[glyph(51,59,12,22)]

    action(['UP'])
    g=glyph(51,59,12,22)
    seq.append(g)
    if i<3: print(i+1, list(g))
    if g==seq[0]:
        print("cycle closed at", i+1); break
print("blue0 unchanged:", glyph(40,48,12,22)==blue0)
print("seq len:", len(seq))
for i,g in enumerate(seq):
